title: Perplexity rolls out Multiagent system where a lead agent splits tasks across specialized agents using different frontier models
content:
X author: @perplexity_ai

Perplexity AI shipped Multiagent, a new effort level in which a lead agent decomposes tasks, delegates to a team of agents powered by different frontier models that share findings, with the lead synthesizing a final answer.
